scheme.nonce: 16 random bytes as 32 lowercase hex characters, single use per verifier; recorded only when the act's effect commits
scheme.order: prefix; strict parse; canonical bytes; fields; known act; field values; subject; team; audience; vocabulary; lifetime; not yet valid; expired; the current team key; the signature; the nonce; the expected subject
scheme.signature: detached Ed25519 by the team's current controller key, raw standard base64 without padding
scheme.signing_bytes: the ASCII prefix 'aweb.owner-act/1' and a newline, then the act's strict canonical JSON (the hook event rules: sorted keys, printable ASCII, no floats, no null)
scheme.times: issued_at and expires_at are UTC to the second; expires_at - issued_at is at most 600 seconds; issued_at may lead the verifier by at most 60 seconds
scheme.verify: each case's verify object is what the verifier knows independently: its team, the team key read fresh from the registry, its own audience and vocabulary, its clock, the stored subject when it has one, and whether the nonce was used
